name: Deposit
description: Deposits laid down thickest at the bottom and thinning as they build.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 4%, transparent 4% 7%, #000 7% 16%, transparent 16% 21%, #000 21% 38%, transparent 38% 46%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 4%, transparent 4% 7%, #000 7% 16%, transparent 16% 21%, #000 21% 38%, transparent 38% 46%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
